headline: Executive order creates a federal Enrichment Oversight Committee.
what_it_does: This 1998 order set up a new committee in the executive branch called the Enrichment Oversight Committee. Based on the title, the committee's job is oversight related to enrichment, most likely uranium enrichment used for nuclear fuel. No summary was provided, so the committee's exact members, powers, and duties are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Some officials would likely serve on or work with the new committee, though the source does not say which ones.
